title: TEST knobs on the flanger page (emulator only)
author: naturarum
description: FOR THE EMULATOR ONLY, DO NOT FLASH. Two new parameter rows on the empty knobs E and F of the flanger (chorus) page, through param-grow, drawn and turned by the stock page code and never p-lockable. TEST (row 0x17f) has MIDI CC 3 and NRPN 307 on the FX channel and shares k 48 with the hidden stock row Reverb FX Routing so that the stock kit storage keeps its value, which is why it must not go on a unit. TST2 (row 0x17e) uses k 87, which the stock storage does not keep. A test of dn2-cfw's GT01 build (GT1T).
